FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The resource block contains diagnostic, hardware, and electronics information. There are no linkable inputs or outputs to the resource block. [function block = Resource block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The sensor transducer block contains sensor information and the ability to calibrate the pressure sensor or recall factory calibration. [function block = Sensor transducer block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The LCD display transducer block is used to configure the LCD display meter. [function block = LCD transducer block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The Analog Input (AI) function block processes the measurements from the sensor and makes them available to other function blocks. The output value from the AI block is in engineering units and contains a status indicating the quality of the measurement. The AI block is widely used for scaling functionality. [function block = Analog input block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The Input Selector (ISEL) function block can be used to select the first good, hot backup, maximum, minimum, or average of as many as eight input values and place it at the output. The block supports signal status propagation. [function block = Input selector block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The Integrator (INT) function block integrates one or two variables over time. The block compares the integrated or accumulated value to pre-trip and trip limits and generates discrete output signals when the limits are reached. The INT function block is used as a totalizer. This block will accept up to two inputs, has six options how to totalize the inputs, and two trip outputs. [function block = Integrator block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The Arithmetic (ARTH) function block provides the ability to configure a range extension function for a primary input. It can also be used to compute nine different arithmetic functions including flow with partial density compensation, electronic remote seals, hydrostatic tank gaging, ratio control, and others. [function block = Arithmetic block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The Signal Characterizer (SGCR) function block characterizes or approximates any function that defines an input/output relationship. The function is defined by configuring as many as 20 X,Y coordinates. The block interpolates an output value for a given input value using the curve defined by the configured coordinates. Two separate analog input signals can be processed simultaneously to give two corresponding separate output values using the same defined curve. [function block = Signal characterizer block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The PID function block combines all of the necessary logic to perform proportional/integral/ derivative PID control. The block supports mode control, signal scaling and limiting, feed forward control, override tracking, alarm limit detection, and signal status propagation. [function block = PID block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The control selector function block selects one of two or three inputs to be the output. The inputs are normally connected to the outputs of PID or other function blocks. One of the inputs would be considered normal and the other two overrides. [function block = Control selector block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]

FOUNDATION Fieldbus function blocks (option A01) | Description = The output splitter function block provides the capability to drive two control outputs from a single input. It takes the output of one PID or other control block to control two valves or other actuators. [function block = Output splitter block; output protocol = FOUNDATION™ Fieldbus (output code F)]
